content: We follow BIBREF2's implementation (https://github.com/dmis-lab/biobert): We add a randomly initialized softmax classifier on top of the last BERT layer to predict the labels. We finetune the entire model to minimize negative log likelihood, with the standard Adam optimizer BIBREF20 and a linear learning rate scheduler (10% warmup). Like BIBREF2, we finetune on the concatenation of the training and development set. All finetuning runs were done on a GeForce Titan X GPU (12GB).
